title: Ancient Wisdom, Modern Tools: Exploring Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Ancient Indian Philosophy
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the performance of LLMs on Advaita Vedanta, a spiritual and philosophical tradition within Hinduism. It specifically evaluates the models on their ability to interpret religious scriptures (Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita), understand Sanskrit religious terminology, and provide accurate answers to spiritual inquiries using experts from a religious society.
